# Part 2: Create an array of the correct length to store the even numbers EVEN_NUMBERS = Array() EVEN_NUMBERS.set_length(COUNT) # Pre-allocate an array of fixed size
# Part 3: Populate the EVEN_NUMBERS array with the even numbers INDEX = 0 loop I from 0 to NUMBERS.length - 1 if NUMBERS[I] mod 2 == 0 then EVEN_NUMBERS[INDEX] = NUMBERS[I] INDEX = INDEX + 1 end if end loop
# Part 4: Perform bubble sort on the EVEN_NUMBERS array loop I from 0 to EVEN_NUMBERS.length - 2 loop J from 0 to EVEN_NUMBERS.length - I - 2 if EVEN_NUMBERS[J] < EVEN_NUMBERS[J + 1] then TEMP = EVEN_NUMBERS[J] EVEN_NUMBERS[J] = EVEN_NUMBERS[J + 1] EVEN_NUMBERS[J + 1] = TEMP end if end loop end loop
